content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Winston-Salem

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP requires either a bachelor's degree plus project-management experience, or a high school diploma with significantly more experience. Review PMI's formal education and work-hour requirements before applying. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify which pathway fits your background.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere—no travel required. Our instructors, active certified practitioners, cover the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application. You'll earn all required contact hours in one cohort.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process. PMI will review your credentials and approve your eligibility to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a Pearson Vue testing center on your timeline. Pass the computer-based PMP exam to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. Maintain it by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or authorship. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current in project-management practice.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
